state:
**Goal `plain-comments` is reached.** Both of its checks pass:
`bun nv proofs --comments docs/examples tests/hostile benches/members` exits 0, and
`bun nv proofs --gate` says nothing is owed in the whole roster.

The floor is green on this host again. WSL `Ubuntu-24.04` starts, and Docker Desktop's engine was
restarted after it stuck at `stopping`. `bun nv db-matrix --all` prints `8/8 legs ok`: the five TCP
drivers and the three AF_UNIX legs. The TSan, prefix fuzz and WSL tree sync checks failed only on
the WSL start timeout and were not re-run by hand; the driver's sweep runs them.

`bun nv verify --doc` resolves every link, and `bun nv owners --closes plain-comments` and
`bun nv playbook --closes plain-comments` name nothing.
